entries.zh: 亲密的朋友，至交；交情深厚。
entries.en: intimate friends; close and trusted friends.
entries.notes: R 栏末字对音不与“厚”相应，依 H“親厚”与 M 音定“至交”。

entries.zh: 心腹之交，情同骨肉的朋友（“心膂”谓至亲至近）。
entries.en: bosom friends, dear as one's own heart and entrails.
entries.notes: H 第二字标 [疑:膂/脊]，且 M 与 R 音节数不一，取“心膂”喻至亲义。

entries.zh: 知己，知心朋友（如同另一个自己）。
entries.en: an intimate friend who knows one's inmost heart; a second self.
entries.notes: H 第二字 [疑:巳/己]；按西班牙语“como el mismo”（如同自身）定为“知己”。

entries.zh: 说合，从中撮合，使双方结为朋友。
entries.en: to make people friends; to bring about a friendship, to reconcile.

entries.zh: 结交，聚合相交而成朋友。
entries.en: to join together in friendship; to associate and become friends.
entries.notes: H 首字作“佐”，M 音合“做會”（聚会、结交），依西班牙语“juntarse en amistad”取结交义。

entries.zh: 契合，志意相投、彼此投合的朋友。
entries.en: friends in mutual accord; congenial friends of one mind.

entries.zh: 得心，得其心意、彼此知心的朋友。
entries.en: friends who have won each other's heart; heart-to-heart friends.
entries.notes: 西班牙语作“saben el coraçon”（知心），而 H、M 均作“得心”，取“得其心”义。

entries.zh: 反面，翻脸反目，断绝朋友交情。
entries.en: to fall out; to turn against each other and break off the friendship.

entries.zh: 反骨，背主负恩、对君主或尊长不忠之人。
entries.en: a turncoat; one of traitorous nature, disloyal to his king or superiors.

entries.zh: 恩情，彼此施恩受惠的厚谊。
entries.en: mutual kindness and obligation; the bond between friends who have benefited each other.

entries.zh: 恩爱，情爱深厚（用于至亲或夫妇）。
entries.en: deep mutual affection; devoted love.

entries.zh: 人情意好，情意深厚、为人厚道的好友。
entries.en: a perfect friend; one of good will and warm feeling.
entries.notes: H 四字“人情意好”与 M、R 音节相当，惟 R 首音不合，释义依“情意好”。

entries.zh: 私和，私下和睦相与；和气有礼的朋友。
entries.en: courteous, well-disposed friends; to be on amicable private terms.
entries.notes: “私和”本指私下和解，用以对译“corteses”（有礼、和气）稍宽，取和睦相与义。

entries.zh: 相同心腹，同心同德、性情相合的朋友。
entries.en: friends of one heart, alike in temper and mind.

entries.zh: 得宠，受君主宠信的人；最受宠爱的近人。
entries.en: a favourite (of a king); one who enjoys his ruler's favour.

entries.zh: 家和，一家人和睦相亲。
entries.en: family harmony; goodwill among members of one household.

entries.zh: 准和，准许和好、允许结交。
entries.en: to permit friendship; to sanction a reconciliation.
entries.notes: “准和”不经见，按“准（允许）＋和（和好）”字面与西班牙语“permitir la amistad”定。

entries.zh: 二人相倚，两人相互倚靠（喻朋友彼此依存）。
entries.en: two friends leaning on each other; a friendship of mutual reliance.
entries.notes: R 栏对音残乱不可据，M 末音节另带污损记号（T99），释义仅依 H“二人相倚”定夺。

entries.zh: 相放伴，彼此作伴、互相帮衬，分担对方的劳苦。
entries.en: to keep each other company and help carry one another's burdens.

entries.zh: 磨，研磨（使器物锋利）。
entries.en: to grind; to sharpen (amolar).

entries.zh: 磨利，磨得锋利。
entries.en: to grind until sharp; to sharpen.
entries.notes: H 中间一字标 [疑:陽/傷]，M 对音亦不合常读，依“磨……利”与西班牙语定“磨使锋利”。
